an9.40:1.1: 40 yasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye āraññakassa nāgassa gocarapasutassa hatthīpi hatthiniyopi hatthikuḷabhāpi hatthicchāpāpi purato purato gantvā tiṇaggāni chindanti tena bhikkhave āraññako nāgo aṭṭiyati harāyati jigucchati
an9.40:1.2: yasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye āraññakassa nāgassa gocarapasutassa hatthīpi hatthiniyopi hatthikuḷabhāpi hatthicchāpāpi obhaggobhaggaṃ sākhābhaṅgaṃ khādanti tena bhikkhave āraññako nāgo aṭṭiyati harāyati jigucchati
an9.40:1.3: yasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye āraññakassa nāgassa ogāhaṃ otiṇṇassa hatthīpi hatthiniyopi hatthikuḷabhāpi hatthicchāpāpi purato purato gantvā soṇḍāya udakaṃ āloḷenti tena bhikkhave āraññako nāgo aṭṭiyati harāyati jigucchati
an9.40:1.4: yasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye āraññakassa nāgassa ogāhaṃ otiṇṇassa hatthiniyo kāyaṃ upaghaṃsantiyo gacchanti tena bhikkhave āraññako nāgo aṭṭiyati harāyati jigucchati
an9.40:2.1: tasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye āraññakassa nāgassa evaṃ hoti
an9.40:2.2: ahaṃ kho etarahi ākiṇṇo viharāmi hatthīhi hatthinīhi hatthikuḷabhehi hatthicchāpehi
an9.40:2.3: chinnaggāni ceva tiṇāni khādāmi obhaggobhaggañca me sākhābhaṅgaṃ khāditaṃ āvilāni ca pānīyāni pivāmi ogāhāpi ca me uttiṇṇassa hatthiniyo kāyaṃ upaghaṃsantiyo gacchanti
an9.40:2.5: so aparena samayena eko gaṇasmā vūpakaṭṭho viharati acchinnaggāni ceva tiṇāni khādati na obhaggobhaggañca sākhābhaṅgaṃ khādati anāvilāni ca pānīyāni pivati ogāhāpi cassa uttiṇṇassa hatthiniyo kāyaṃ na upaghaṃsantiyo gacchanti
an9.40:3.1: tasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye āraññakassa nāgassa evaṃ hoti
an9.40:3.2: ahaṃ kho pubbe ākiṇṇo vihāsiṃ hatthīhi hatthinīhi hatthikuḷabhehi hatthicchāpehi chinnaggāni ceva tiṇāni khādiṃ obhaggobhaggañca me sākhābhaṅgaṃ khāditaṃ āvilāni ca pānīyāni apāsi ogāhā ca me uttiṇṇassa hatthiniyo kāyaṃ upaghaṃsantiyo agamaṃsu somhi etarahi eko gaṇasmā vūpakaṭṭho viharāmi acchinnaggāni ceva tiṇāni khādāmi obhaggobhaggañca me sākhābhaṅgaṃ khāditaṃ anāvilāni ca pānīyāni pivāmi ogāhāpi ca me uttiṇṇassa na hatthiniyo kāyaṃ upaghaṃsantiyo gacchantīti so soṇḍāya sākhābhaṅgaṃ bhañjitvā sākhābhaṅgena kāyaṃ parimajjitvā attamano kaṇḍuṃ saṃhanati.
an9.40:4.1: evameva kho bhikkhave yasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu ākiṇṇo viharati bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīhi upāsakehi upāsikāhi raññā rājamahāmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhave bhikkhussa evaṃ hoti
an9.40:4.2: ahaṃ kho etarahi ākiṇṇo viharāmi bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīhi upāsakehi upāsikāhi raññā rājamahāmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi
an9.40:4.4: so vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ
an9.40:4.5: so araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā
an9.40:5.1: so abhijjhaṃ loke pahāya vigatābhijjhena cetasā viharati abhijjhāya cittaṃ parisodheti
an9.40:5.2: byāpādapadosaṃ pahāya abyāpannacitto viharati sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī byāpādapadosā cittaṃ parisodheti
an9.40:5.3: thīnamiddhaṃ pahāya vigatathīnamiddho viharati ālokasaññī sato sampajāno thīnamiddhā cittaṃ parisodheti
an9.40:5.4: uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahāya anuddhato viharati ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto uddhaccakukkuccā cittaṃ parisodheti
an9.40:5.5: vicikicchaṃ pahāya tiṇṇavicikiccho viharati akathaṃkathī kusalesu vicikicchāya cittaṃ parisodheti
an9.40:5.6: so ime pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetasā upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe
an9.40:5.7: vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an9.40:6.1: sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ananto ākāsoti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
an9.40:6.3: sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati …pe…
an9.40:6.4: sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
an9.40:6.5: sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
an9.40:6.6: sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati paññāyapassa disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā honti
